// Auto-generated by generate-client.js. Do not edit manually.
const API_BASE_URL = {{{apiBaseUrl}}}
const MSGPACK_CONTENT_TYPE = 'application/msgpack'

let msgPackModulePromise

async function getMsgPackModule() {
    if (!msgPackModulePromise) {
        msgPackModulePromise = import({{{msgpackUrl}}})
    }

    return msgPackModulePromise
}

export async function request(path, method, authenticationParams = {}, urlParams = {}, params = {}, contentType = 'application/json', accept = 'application/json') {
    const isGet = method === 'GET'
    const isMsgPack = contentType === MSGPACK_CONTENT_TYPE
    const hasAuthenticationParams = Object.keys(authenticationParams).length > 0

    const queryString = new URLSearchParams(
        Object.entries(params ?? {}).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined).map(([key, value]) => [key, String(value)])
    ).toString()

    const resolvedPath = Object.entries(urlParams).reduce(
        (currentPath, [name, value]) => currentPath.replaceAll(`{${name}}`, encodeURIComponent(String(value))),
        path
    )
    
    const url = isGet
        ? `${API_BASE_URL}${resolvedPath}${queryString ? `?${queryString}` : ''}`
        : `${API_BASE_URL}${resolvedPath}`

    const response = await fetch(url, {
        method,
        headers: {
            Accept: accept,
            ...(isGet ? {} : { 'Content-Type': contentType }),
            ...(hasAuthenticationParams
                ? { Authorization: JSON.stringify(authenticationParams) }
                : {})
        },
        body: isGet
            ? undefined
            : isMsgPack
                ? (await getMsgPackModule()).encode(params)
                : JSON.stringify(params)
    })

    const responseContentType = response.headers.get('content-type') ?? ''
    let payload

    try {
        payload = responseContentType.includes(MSGPACK_CONTENT_TYPE)
            ? (await getMsgPackModule()).decode(new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer()))
            : await response.json()
    } catch (error) {
        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`Request failed with status ${response.status}`)
        }
        throw error
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(payload?.error ?? `Request failed with status ${response.status}`)
    }

    return payload.result
}
